The '''Cron Supernova''', also known as the '''Cron Drift Explosion''', was the destruction of the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]] in [[3996 BBY]], during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War's]] [[Battle of Kemplex Nine]]. [[Aleema Keto]] unwittingly caused it using [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]].<ref name="sithwar4" /> The blast devastated [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and created the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[11 ABY/Legends|Four millennia later]], the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] involvement in the Supernova was disregarded as a legend by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Historian/Legends|historians]] such as [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]].<ref name="Corellia Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>
